Name: Intuitive Surgical Inc
Description: Intuitive Surgical, Inc. is a leading American company specializing in robotic-assisted surgical technologies aimed at enhancing patient outcomes through minimally invasive procedures. Best known for its flagship da Vinci Surgical System, the company not only focuses on developing innovative surgical platforms but also offers a comprehensive suite of instruments and accessories, as well as training and support for healthcare providers. With a robust pipeline of advanced technologies, Intuitive Surgical is positioned for growth in the expanding field of robotic surgery, ultimately contributing to improved surgical precision and patient recovery.
